Project.How do you plan to prepare the dataset:
Data Sharding and Encryption: Use tools like IPFS to split raw data into shards (e.g., in CAR file format) and optionally encrypt them (e.g., with AES) for security.

Generating Storage Deals: Create storage deals via Lotus or Boost clients, defining parameters (replicas, storage duration, etc.) and generating a Piece CID (unique data identifier).

Data Transfer: Transmit sharded data to Storage Providers (SPs) via HTTP or GraphSync protocol, ensuring network stability and transfer efficiency.

Deal Verification & On-Chain Submission: After receiving data, SPs generate storage proofs (e.g., PoRep) and submit the transaction to the Filecoin blockchain via on-chain messages.

Monitoring & Repair: Use Prometheus or custom scripts to monitor storage status, regularly check replica health, and trigger repair processes (e.g., re-sealing) if failures occur.

Toolchain: IPFS/Lotus/Boost, CAR splitting tools (e.g., go-car), encryption libraries (OpenSSL), GraphSync/HTTP, Filecoin Virtual Machine (FVM).
